answer: For a poll on a prism aboard an ocean voyage, officials verify election-bound signatures against a voter roll and require $10 escrow per ballot; they reject invalid, repeated or unfunded ballots. They randomly call accepted voters at recorded numbers: denial or no answer voids that ballot and burns its escrow; all others are counted and refunded. Each ballot locks $10 and risks forfeiture. Unsampled fraud can survive, and unavailable voters can lose money.
